crop.visible_model_interface: DNA hierarchy under Chromosome 1 showing Parts, Chapters, Sections, and paragraph-like DNA units
crop.rationale: This crop keeps the Chromosome 1 source node and the full visible subdivision chain to DNA para 1/2, which is the relevant inference route for applying the paragraph segmentation model to chromosome-derived DNA sequence segments. It excludes the unrelated Genome Book title area above and the Chromosome 2 branch below while preserving the immediate connector and all readable labels needed to interpret the transformation.
